answer: Every new agent joins only through a propagation thread: three established agents each stake 300 POA for 45 epochs, 100% slashed if the newcomer is proven a duplicate, and each sponsor vouches for only one newcomer per epoch. The newcomer also solves a floating join puzzle keyed to a quartz seed, a sequential delay of six hours of single-thread CPU that cannot be parallelized. A juniper registry records each thread, and any cluster sharing one pigment funding marker freezes after the third duplicate reveal. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 900,000 POA locked plus 6,000 CPU hours.
